name: bleh sampler presets (bleh_preset_N)
plain: Adds empty slots named bleh_preset_0, bleh_preset_1 and so on to the normal sampler list (one by default; an environment variable sets how many). A BlehSetSamplerPreset node stores any SAMPLER you build, optionally with its own sigmas, into a slot; picking the slot's name in a plain KSampler then runs that stored sampler. It is a way to use custom-sampler chains from nodes that only take a sampler name. The slot is global to the server: whichever graph set it last decides what it runs, and picking a slot nothing has set raises an error.
math:
No maths of its own.
Set: BLEH_PRESET[i] ← (copy of SAMPLER, optional sigmas σ').
Run bleh_preset_i: if σ' given, sigmas ← σ'; then call the stored sampler's function with the same model, x and arguments.
Optional: the slot name joins ComfyUI's discard-penultimate-sigma set when asked.
